correctness.rationale: Directly reconstructed the graph and token-move definitions. The exhaustive classification uses the fact that the only nonzero legal length-four word is ABBA and none extends to length five. The cyclic five-window count bounds alpha, and explicit words attain it. The deficit-zero run argument forces five periodic optima for n=5k and three translated defect classes for n=5k+4. A complete exchange analysis distinguishes same-column A/B flips from moves of an empty column, giving precisely X_i-Y_i, X_i-Z_i, Y_i-Z_{i+5}. The five-step index shift generates Z_n because gcd(n,5)=1. The two standalone scripts were actually executed from current package working paths and agree on enumerated sets and all exchanges; the infinite claim depends on the elementary proof, not the finite tests. No n≡1,2,3 assertion is made.

originality.rationale: The claim is the exact exchange-graph isomorphism J(GP(5k,2)) = 5 isolated vertices and J(GP(5k+4,2)) = one 3n-cycle, with all token jumps also token slides. Previously established independence numbers and even previously available counts of maximum sets are expressly excluded as novel. Direct inspection of primary generalized-Petersen independence and minimum-cover articles shows no one-for-one exchange graph theorem; the foundational reconfiguration article treats general complexity rather than this exact family. Earlier enumerator and prism-exchange results do not logically imply the cycle adjacency. Residual risk of an inaccessible exact 2009 cover-paper or differently titled equivalent treatment is recorded; no claim that searches prove uniqueness.
residual_risks: The full text of Behzad, Hatami and Mahmoodian (2009) was inaccessible; its abstract mentions size only but cannot rule out an unadvertised reconfiguration classification.
An equivalent result could be indexed under fixed-size minimum vertex-cover transformations, stability exchanges, or generalized Petersen cyclic words; searches are not novelty proof.
The prior polynomial already implies the counts 5 and 3n, which must not be represented as original results.

value.rationale: The graph GP(n,2) is a standard cubic family with the classical 4/5 packing period. Exact count of optimal configurations and their ability to move are different invariants: the theorem exhibits an infinite rigid length class followed one column before the next period by a completely mobile defect cycle. It determines every allowed reconfiguration, shows token jumping gives no advantage over token sliding in these classes, and gives explicit diameter for all lengths 5k+4. The index-shift mechanism explains the mobility phase change; it is not an arbitrary enumeration or a corollary of known alpha/count formulas.
